info.title: CashKr Admin API — Infrastructure 4
info.description: Tags: linode, services, sidekick, upload-image, uploads

put.summary: Update Linode budgets, thresholds and Slack webhook
put.description:
Partially updates the Linode cost settings: budgets (non-numeric or negative values are dropped), alert thresholds (clamped to their valid ranges) and the Slack webhook override. Responds with the same payload as GET.

**Notes:** Persistent configuration change: sets the alerting webhook and budget/threshold values used by the Linode alerting job. An unparseable body is treated as {} (no-op) rather than a 400.

_Source: `app/api/linode/settings/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

200.description: Updated - returns the full GET payload

400.description: Slack webhook URL has the wrong host

post.summary: Trigger a manual Linode live sync
post.description:
Runs runLiveSync, which pulls current account, resource and usage data from the Linode API into the local tables, and returns the sync result plus the elapsed duration.

**Notes:** Uses getServerSession(authOptions) directly (any authenticated user, not requireAdminSession). Long-running: maxDuration 300s; performs many outbound Linode API calls and bulk DB writes. Request body is ignored.

_Source: `app/api/linode/sync/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

get.summary: Get Linode transfer pool usage and overage forecast
get.description:
Returns the account transfer pool used/quota GB from the latest snapshot, the used percentage, a projected end-of-month GB figure based on cycle progress, an estimated overage cost in USD, and per-instance transfer usage sorted highest first.

**Notes:** Read-only.

_Source: `app/api/linode/transfer-pool/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

post.description:
Runs the AI sentiment analyzer over a review text and rating and returns its verdict. Intended for the customer app.

**Notes:** not gated by the handler itself: the code comments say the 401 was disabled to simplify testing, so a bad or absent Authorization header only produces a server-side warning.

_Source: `app/api/services/analyze-sentiment/route.ts`_

_Auth: `other: checks Authorization against Bearer CRON_SECRET but does not enforce it — a mismatch only logs a warning and the request proceeds`_

_Audit 2026-09 (stage): security corrected: guarded by `bearerMatches(request.headers.get('authorization'), process.env.CRON_SECRET)`. It was previously documented as unauthenticated._

example.text: Vendor was polite but arrived an hour late.

post.summary: Send a message to the Sidekick AI assistant
post.description:
Runs the OpenAI tool-calling loop for the CashKr Sidekick admin analyst, persisting the user turn and assistant reply to the shared SidekickConversation/SidekickMessage tables. Creates a new conversation when conversationId is omitted.

**Notes:** Calls the OpenAI Chat Completions API upstream (https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions, model from OPENAI_MODEL, default gpt-4o-mini) and costs tokens per call. Per-admin rate limit via lib/sidekick/rate-limit, returns 429 with a Retry-After header. maxDuration 60s, force-dynamic. Up to 5 tool-calling iterations; history capped at 30 turns. Conversations are SHARED across all admins. The assistant is read-only (no write tools).

_Source: `app/api/sidekick/chat/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

messages.content: How many leads did we close this week?

400.description: Last message is not a non-empty user turn

example.error: Last message must be a non-empty user turn.

429.description: Per-admin rate limit reached (Retry-After header set)

example.error: Rate limit reached. Try again in 37s.

get.description:
Lists conversations across all admins ordered by most recent message, with creator name and message count.

**Notes:** Shared across all admins - not scoped to the caller.

_Source: `app/api/sidekick/conversations/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max conversations to return; clamped to 1-200

get.summary: Get a Sidekick conversation with messages
get.description:
Returns a single conversation's metadata plus all its messages in chronological order, including tool-call traces and sender names.

**Notes:** Conversations are shared - any logged-in admin can read any conversation.

_Source: `app/api/sidekick/conversations/[id]/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

messages.content: How many leads did we close this week?

delete.description:
Permanently deletes the conversation and cascade-deletes all of its messages.

**Notes:** Anyone-can-delete policy: any authenticated admin may delete any conversation, including ones they did not create. Cascades to messages.

_Source: `app/api/sidekick/conversations/[id]/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

example.error: Record to delete does not exist.

post.description:
Accepts a multipart image upload, validates that it is an image under 5MB, and stores it in the S3 bucket under the given path and file name. Returns the public URL.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check - anyone can write objects into the S3 bucket. Send as multipart/form-data (do not set Content-Type manually). Uploads via lib/utils/uploadToS3 to AWS S3; the caller-supplied path is used as the key prefix without sanitisation.

_Source: `app/api/upload-image/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

400.description: No file, non-image type, or over 5MB

example.error: File size must be less than 5MB

post.description:
Operation reconstructed from source during the re-audit. Accepts a JSON request body (detected fields: folder, fileName, contentType, size). 

_Source: `app/api/uploads/sign/route.ts`_

_Auth: `cookieAuth`_

ErrorEnvelope.description: Plain error envelope `{ error }` used by most routes. `error` is a human-readable message.

OkErrorDurationEnvelope.description: Job/cron failure envelope `{ ok: false, error, durationMs }`.

messages.description: Chat turns; only the LAST entry (role must be user) is used, truncated to 4000 chars. Earlier turns are ignored - history is loaded from the DB.

conversationId.description: Existing conversation to continue; 404 if it does not exist. Omit to start a new one.

UnspecifiedObject.description: Response body shape not captured by the source re-audit (only the status code was detected). Any JSON object.

file.description: Image file. MIME type must start with image/ and size must be under 5MB.

budgets.description: Map of budget key to USD amount; entries that are not finite numbers >= 0 are ignored

thresholds.minSavingsAlert.description: Minimum monthly savings (USD) worth alerting on, clamped 0-100000

slackWebhookUrl.description: Slack incoming webhook override; must start with https://hooks.slack.com/. Send null or "" to clear the override and fall back to the env value; omit the key to leave it untouched

OkErrorEnvelope.description: Error envelope `{ ok: false, error }` used by cron / sync style routes.

Unauthorized.description: Unauthenticated - no valid admin session (NextAuth cookie), or the expected token/secret is missing or wrong. For operations whose description says *reconstructed from source*, only the status code was detected in the audit; the body shape shown is the codebase convention, not verified per route.

InternalServerError.description: Internal server error - unhandled failure inside the route handler. For operations whose description says *reconstructed from source*, only the status code was detected in the audit; the body shape shown is the codebase convention, not verified per route.

InternalServerErrorOkFlag.description: Internal server error - unhandled failure. Variant for routes that use the `{ ok, error }` envelope.

BadRequest.description: Bad request / validation error - a required field is missing or invalid. For operations whose description says *reconstructed from source*, only the status code was detected in the audit; the body shape shown is the codebase convention, not verified per route.

UnauthorizedOkFlag.description: Unauthenticated - no valid admin session. Variant for routes that use the `{ ok, error }` envelope.

cookieAuth.name: next-auth.session-token
cookieAuth.description: NextAuth JWT session cookie from logging in to the admin panel. On HTTPS the cookie name is `__Secure-next-auth.session-token`.

cronBearer.description: `LINODE_CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token — every cron job goes through `assertCronAuth` in `lib/linode/cron-auth.ts`, which reads only this variable (despite some jobs being non-Linode).

unverifiedAccessToken.name: Authorization
unverifiedAccessToken.description: Legacy customer routes: an `accessToken` cookie or an `Authorization` header must be PRESENT, but the value is never verified. Not real authentication.

adsWebhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
adsWebhookSecret.description: `ADS_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, sent either as the `x-webhook-secret` header or as a `secret` field in the JSON body. If the env var is unset the route rejects every call with 401 (it does not fall through to unauthenticated access).

webhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
webhookSecret.description: Generic `x-webhook-secret` header check for an inbound webhook.

cronSecretBearer.description: `CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token, compared with `bearerMatches` in `lib/auth/secret-compare.ts`. Distinct from `cronBearer`, which uses `LINODE_CRON_SECRET`.
